summary: Add configurable duplicate suppression to POST /api/alerts so recent active alerts with the same title and severity return the existing alert instead of creating a new row.
constraints: Match duplicates by case-insensitive title and exact severity.
Suppress only when the prior matching alert is active.
Suppress only when the prior matching alert was created within the configured window.
Return 200 OK with header X-Duplicate-Suppressed: true when suppression occurs.
Return 201 Created for genuinely new alerts.
Read the suppression window from appsettings.json rather than a hardcoded literal.
Do not suppress across different severities.
Do not suppress when the prior matching alert is inactive.
Use the existing TimeProvider-based UTC clock path.
coverage_goals: Controller coverage for 200/201 branching and duplicate-suppressed response header.
Service coverage for cutoff calculation, duplicate lookup before insert, and new-vs-suppressed outcomes.
Service coverage that different severity, inactive prior alerts, and outside-window prior alerts do not suppress.
Repository coverage for case-insensitive title matching, exact severity, active-only filtering, and created-since cutoff behavior.
